name: Brellium
short_description: AI-powered clinical compliance platform that audits 100% of patient charts against payer, regulatory, and quality standards with reimbursement guarantee.
long_description: Brellium is an AI-powered clinical compliance platform founded in 2021 that automatically audits 100% of patient charts against payer documentation requirements, regulatory standards, and clinical quality benchmarks. Unlike traditional sampling approaches, Brellium reviews every chart in real-time before claims submission, identifying documentation errors and delivering corrective instructions to providers. The platform offers a reimbursement guarantee if a payer initiates clawbacks on approved charts. Serving 250,000+ providers across all 50 states with 100+ payors supported, Brellium customers including Rula, Headspace, Grow Therapy, Talkiatry, and Lightfully Behavioral Health achieve 99.2% provider compliance with documentation standards. The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified, HIPAA compliant with BAA available, and integrates with existing EHRs via SSO/SAML through Okta and Auth0.
one_liner: AI chart auditing platform that reviews 100% of documentation for compliance before billing.
best_for: Large behavioral health organizations needing comprehensive chart auditing
Telehealth platforms managing documentation across many providers
Practices concerned about payer audits and clawback risk
Organizations seeking to improve documentation quality at scale
not_for: Solo practitioners or small practices under 10 providers
Organizations not processing significant claims volume
Budget-constrained organizations seeking basic compliance tools
